name: std::fisher_f_distribution
intro:
Produces random numbers according to the F-distribution:

\(P(x;m,n)=\frac{\Gamma{(\frac{m+n}{2})} }{\Gamma{(\frac{m}{2})}\Gamma{(\frac{n}{2})} }{(\frac{m}{n})}^{\frac{m}{2} }x^{\frac{m}{2}-1}{(1+\frac{m}{n}x)}^{-\frac{m+n}{2} }\)P(x;m,n) = Γ((m+n)/2)Γ(m/2) Γ(n/2)  (m/n)m/2
 x(m/2)-1
 (1+mxn)-(m+n)/2

\(\small m\)m and \(\small n\)n are the degrees of freedom.

std::fisher_f_distribution satisfies all requirements of RandomNumberDistribution.
